en.text:
Direct Hits against <solar/>Scorched Enemies apply 20 additional <solar/>Scorch (30 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) on a 0.5 second cooldown

Scoring 3 Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to <solar/>Scorch the target. This allows The Lament to Scorch through a singular revved attack.

Hit counter persists through stow.

<solar/>Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage, and thus, triggers Revved Consumption's healing, granting 7HP per tick.
